summary: Likely cause found: installed builds mixed NewChirp drivers into chirp/drivers, and released macOS 1.0.77 resolved Retevis_RA89 to upstream th_uv88 (TYT handshake), not newchirp_ra89 (RA89 CPS handshake). The report quotes the TYT handshake, so the owner was probably running the upstream driver.
